title: CORE-7024 · FAQ Quick Navigation label is not an <h4> heading on clone (live is <h4>)
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7024](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7024)

## Verified 2026-08-24 — reproduces

The "FAQs Quick Navigation" dropdown label renders as a plain `<span>` inside the toggle
`<button>` on the clone; live renders it as an `<h4>` in the same button. Rendered type is
identical on both (19px, weight 500) — only the element is wrong.

| | Clone | Live |
|---|---|---|
| `/faqs/vat/` | `<span>` in `<button>` | `<h4>` in `<button>` |
| `/faqs/directors/` | `<span>` in `<button>` | `<h4>` in `<button>` |

Third instance of the same heading-level defect class:
- CORE-7018 — FAQ accordion questions `<h3>` → `<h4>` (PR #89, merged)
- CORE-7007 — closing CTA band `<h2>` → `<h3>` (PR #102, merged)
- CORE-7024 — this one

## Location

`src/components/shared/FaqQuickNav/index.tsx` — the `<Text>` inside the toggle button has no
`as` prop, so it defaults to a `<span>`. Add `as="h4"`.

The `/faqs/` hub has no Quick Navigation dropdown and is unaffected.
acceptanceCriteria: The "FAQs Quick Navigation" label renders as `<h4>` on the clone, inside the same toggle `<button>`, matching live.
Rendered type unchanged — 19px, weight 500, same colour, same position.
The dropdown still opens and closes on click, and `aria-expanded` still toggles on the button.
Verified on at least two FAQ topic pages at 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800; the `/faqs/` hub (no dropdown) is unaffected.
